Metadata.summary: The series follows Eddie Horniman, who has inherited his father's sizeable estate only to discover that it's sitting on top of a weed empire owned by the legendary Bobby Glass. Has this straight-up soldier got what it takes to master the dark arts of the British criminal underworld and take control of the entire operation?
